summary: Bio Green Med Solution, Inc. filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 to report that its Board of Directors declared a regular quarterly cash dividend of $0.15 per share on its 6% Convertible Exchangeable Preferred Stock, payable August 1, 2026, to holders of record July 23, 2026. This is a routine dividend declaration, not a special-situation event. There are no M&A, restructuring, or strategic transaction terms. No advisors or recommendations are cited. The filing is a standard current report of a dividend action, so no special-situation category applies.
